target: The game starts after the break.
note: Restore after the break rather than starting now.

target: Could you check the bank balance today?
note: Add today.

target: The bus will arrive at the station soon.
note: Add at the station soon.

target: We will meet at the cafe downtown tomorrow.
note: Suggestion without the intended downtown location or tomorrow.

target: The pharmacy opens on Sunday.
text: I tell you the pharmacy is open.
note: Remove the reporting frame and add on Sunday.

target: Leave the package by the door.
note: Add by the door.

target: The picnic starts at noon in the park.
text: Let's go to the park for a picnic now.
note: Suggestion to go now instead of a noon start.

target: Please keep the office door closed during lunch.
text: Please keep the office door closed.
note: Add during lunch.

target: The neighbor feeds our cat this morning.
text: I will tell the neighbor to feed the cat.
note: A plan to instruct the neighbor replaces a claim about feeding.

target: The guard checks the gate now.
note: Listener instruction instead of a statement about the guard.

target: The therapist showed me the chart last visit.
text: I need to look at the therapist's chart.
note: My need to look replaces the therapist showing it.

target: We booked the room last week.
text: I booked the room in the past.
note: I replaces we and the date last week is lost.

target: I will pay the bill at the office window tomorrow.
text: I’ll pay the bill at the office later.
note: Use at the office window tomorrow.

target: My friend invites Sam to the picnic this weekend.
note: Add to the picnic this weekend.

target: The dog waits outside the kitchen door.
note: Asks me to wait instead of describing the dog waiting.

target: I cooked the vegetables in the kitchen yesterday.
text: I cooked vegetables in the past.
note: Restore in the kitchen yesterday.

target: Does the class meet in the upstairs room?
note: Asks about having class today, not where the class meets.

target: I didn't finish the report before lunch.
note: A future completion replaces whether I finished before lunch.

target: I prepared lunch in the kitchen this morning.
text: I had lunch in the kitchen.
note: Eating lunch replaces preparing it and loses the date.

target: My friend brings photos to the café tonight.
text: I will show them photos of my friend later.
note: Showing photos of my friend replaces my friend bringing photos.

target: Call my aunt after lunch.
note: Add after lunch.

target: Save a seat beside the stage.
text: I will save the seat for you.
note: An offer by me replaces a request to the listener.

target: You read the note beside the phone.
note: Add beside the phone.

target: You check the forms in the office.
note: Add in the office and the before forms.

target: The mechanic fixes the car in the garage.
note: Name the mechanic and add in the garage.

target: The bank may send the card today.
note: My desire for a card replaces whether the bank sends it today.

target: The advisor reads my access request.
note: Add my access request and remove will.

target: The driver does not know the hospital entrance.
note: Add the hospital entrance.

target: The clinic does not have my test results.
text: I do not have the clinic results.
note: Changes the subject from clinic to me.

target: Did the rent payment leave my account yesterday?
text: Will I have to leave to pay my rent?
note: Asks about leaving to pay rent, not whether payment left the account.

target: The clinic may call after lunch.
text: I need to make a clinic call.
note: Changes the clinic calling into my need to call the clinic.

target: Please call my sister after the meeting.
note: Add my before sister and after the meeting.

target: My aunt does not remember the new address.
note: Makes me remember my aunt instead of my aunt remembering the address.

target: The headphones will block the traffic noise.
note: Add will and the traffic noise.

target: The shuttle will stop near the library.
text: I need to know the shuttle stop.
note: Names a shuttle stop rather than a shuttle possibly stopping near the library.

target: The soup contains dairy ingredients.
note: Contains has no object; it never states whether dairy is present.

target: The office will approve my ramp request.
text: I am sure the office will approve.
note: Restore my ramp request.

target: The museum permits visitors to sketch.
note: A museum permit is a thing; neither version asks for one.

target: The library does not lend board games.
note: Add board games.

target: I will send the access request tomorrow.
note: Asks the listener to send something instead of stating my plan.
